about.title: QCEP settings description, engine 10
about.purpose: What every key of every settings file is. The engine reads each settings file through one reader (settingsDoor.js) that uses this description to give every key one form in memory: one value bare, a list always a list, a setting that is not set absent. The launcher, the pre-flight, and later the PHP and QCEB read this same file.

reading.kind: one | list | group | table | byTrialType. A group with keysNamedBy is a group whose keys someone other than the platform chooses; its entry describes every key. A table is a list of rows; row describes each row. A list describes its items.
reading.anyOf: the key takes one of several described forms. An array takes the list or table form when there is one; an object (or an object inside a list of one) takes a group form; anything else takes a one-value form. Of several group forms, the one sharing most keys with the value is taken.
reading.byTrialType: the form is set by the frame's trialType; otherTypes covers a trial type not named.
reading.value: text, html, number, integer, boolean, oneOf (see oneOf), any, or a name: fileName, columnName, blockName, setName, sessionKey, keyMapName, keyMapLabel, keyName, character, url, email, colour, cssLength, cardRegion, elementId, address, baseName, relativePath, pluginName, trialTypeName, frameName, jsonText.
reading.optional: true when the key may be absent. Absent means not set.
reading.default: {value, appliedBy}: appliedBy is qceb (written into the file), engine (used when absent), both, or server.
reading.open: contents belong to a plugin, a stimulus set or the study; passed through untouched
reading.otherKeys: what a key not listed is; a key not listed is always passed through untouched
reading.nullMeans: the value a JSON null stands for in this key
reading.data: a value inside data, not a setting: never cut, converted or reported; read as the file wrote it
reading.dead: read or written, never used by the engine
reading.qcebWrites: false: QCEB does not write this key for engine 10
reading.absentMeans: what the engine does when the key is absent, where that is not a default value
reading.studyOwnUnwrap: contents belong to the study. In a file without settingsForm a list of exactly one is read as its item and a longer list is kept whole, at the top level (oneLevel) or at every depth (deep). In a file with settingsForm 2 they are untouched.

showIf.note: told apart by which key is present; QCEB cannot write the formula kind

session.note: required for entry/exit; absent for experimentStart

otherKeys.note: written by QCEB, never read by the engine

op.note: gate and showIf only; a card field has none

value.note: gate and showIf only; full precision

switchToSet.note: block rule; absent = stop the block

switchToBlock.note: top-level rule; absent = end the session

groupName.note: required by the engine; optional to the server

nPerBlock.note: all groups or none; read by the server only

plugins.note: launcher reads plugins at any depth

root.note: every top-level key is a group

settingsForm.absentMeans: one value may be written inside a list of one
settingsForm.note: 2: one value is written bare, a list always as a list, and a setting that is not set is left out

keyMap.note: labels; a label with one key is still a list

default.value: Please take a self-timed break. Press any key to resume the experiment.
We may present this screen again during the experiment to remind you of the keys.

otherKeys.note: a study's own setting, handed whole to hooks as ctx.dbConfig; passed through untouched in both forms

blockName.note: unique; falls back to the key

keyMapName.note: a name from the group settings keyMaps, or "none" for no key map (legal only on a block without key-response frames)

set.note: a scenario is in one set; a list is read as its first entry, with a warning

anyOf.note: a SurveyJS model as JSON text
a SurveyJS model as an object

choices.note: a list of keys (a list of one is still a list), or one of the words ALL_KEYS, NO_KEYS written bare

pluginParams.note: the plugin's own parameters, spread onto the trial

outputVariables.note: data, not settings: passed through whole, as written, in both forms; each column holds one value, and a missing value is null in a file with settingsForm 2

otherKeys.note: a study's own scenario key, handed to hooks in ctx.scenarios; passed through untouched in both forms

root.note: passed whole to hooks as ctx.scenarios

placements.note: anchor fields sit flat in each row

formula.note: exactly one of formula, bind; no op or value
